description: Meme built on a news photograph of a U.S. House Democratic leadership press conference: Nancy Pelosi in a yellow dress speaks at a lectern bearing the U.S. House seal, flanked by Adam Schiff, Elijah Cummings (standing with a walker) and Jerrold Nadler, with U.S. flags behind them and a partially visible poster comparing Mueller investigation outcomes. Overlaid caption text asserts the impeachment effort is not about Trump's corruption but about hiding the Democrats' own corruption. A "Freedom of Press" skull logo watermark sits at lower right.

description: Dark-themed screenshot of Q drop #3532, titled "The Swamp Runs Deep", from a Q aggregator app, tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, dated 28 Jul 2019. The drop claims DNC servers hold answers, invokes a "SCARAMUCCI MODEL", references DNI & NSA, and bracket-tags [AWAN], [DWS] (Debbie Wasserman Schultz) and [D_Congress], ending with a plea-deal taunt alluding to the Imran Awan case.
text: 3532. The Swamp Runs Deep. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 28 Jul 2019 - 7:53:47 PM. The SWAMP runs deep. DNC server(s) hold many answers. SCARAMUCCI MODEL. DNI & NSA. [AWAN]. [DWS]. [D_Congress]. House of Cards. You didn't think the plea deal was the end did you?. Q
flags: All content is the Q drop's claim; the DNC-server and Awan insinuations are unverified conspiracy assertions
Bracketed names are Q shorthand; identifications of Awan/Wasserman Schultz/Scaramucci are from the drop's text, not imagery

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2943 as displayed on the dark-themed "Qanon Drops" aggregator site, titled "When Will Americans Wake up to the [D] Party Con?", tripcode !!mG7VJxZNCI, dated 3 Mar 2019. The drop links a Ted Lieu tweet, a DOJ press release and the Rod Rosenstein memo on the Mueller special-counsel scope, quotes the scope-authorization language, and insinuates that a classified "scope #2" was enacted to expand the Mueller probe beyond its intended mandate. A hand-drawn yellow highlight circle marks the scope-authorization paragraph; the drop's rendering shows "James 8. Corney", an OCR-style corruption of James B. Comey. The bottom of the drop is cut off mid-line.
text: Qanon Drops. Lang: en. 2943. When Will Americans Wake up to the [D] Party Con?. Q !!mG7VJxZNCI 3 Mar 2019 - 6:17:55 PM. https://twitter.com/tedlieu/status/1102265163107971077. More statements made (evidence) without presenting facts.. If 'evidence' exists(ed), under 'broad' scope #1, would Mueller have the auth to pursue?. https://www.justice.gov/opa/press-release/file/967231/download. The Special Counsel is authorized to conduct the investigation confinned by then-FBI Director James 8. Corney in testimony before the House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence on March 20, 2017, including:. (i) any links and/or coordination between the Russian government and individuals associated with the campaign of President Donald Trump; and. (ii) any matters that arose or may arise directly from the investigation; and. (iii) any other matters within the scope of 28 C.F.R. § 600.4(a).. Because no evidence exists(ed) and/or was found by SC/Mueller, was scope #2 enacted in an attempt to go outside of the 'intended engagement'?. https://www.documentcloud.org/documents/4429989-Rod-Rosenstein-memo-outlining-scope-of-Mueller.html. Why is scope #2 classified only to AG/DAG and a select few others (read at terminal only)?
orgs: House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence
flags: The drop's insinuation that 'scope #2' was enacted without evidence is an unverified claim
'confinned' and 'James 8. Corney' are OCR artifacts in the quoted DOJ text; the person is FBI Director James B. Comey
Screenshot is cropped at the bottom mid-line; any remaining drop text is not visible

description: Photoshopped meme of an ornate red-and-gold private home theater in which several cartoon Pepe the Frog figures sit in plush seats eating popcorn while watching Donald Trump on the screen; the on-screen Trump sits at a desk with papers flying through the air. It visualises the Q-community catchphrase "enjoy the show" — followers watching predicted events unfold.
flags: Pepe the Frog is used here as a generic 4chan/Q-community mascot; the character has separately been catalogued as a hate symbol in some contexts
